sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- IRNA/Tasnim via Reuters (T1) + Al Jazeera liveblog (T2)] Two missiles struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz on the night of Nov 6-7: IRNA reported locals heard an aircraft sound before two projectiles 'impacted in the Susa area'; Tasnim reported two missile impacts, stressing no official information on damage; semi-official outlets reported no casualties. [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- Iranian army statement via IRIB, 23:06 GMT] Iran's air defence 'intercepted and destroyed' a US MQ-9 drone over Qeshm Island. [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- CENTCOM official to Al Jazeera, 22:55 GMT] The situation around Qeshm is 'relatively calm'; CENTCOM 'will issue an announcement concerning Iran at 8:30am EST (13:30 GMT) on Saturday' but declined to disclose its content. [CONTEXT -- prior Qeshm pattern] US carried out limited 'defensive' strikes on Qeshm Nov 2 after Iran downed a drone (WSJ/JPost, recorded); IRGC claimed its 56th MQ-9 on Nov 4 and its 16th MQ-1 on Nov 6 (recorded 2100-02 Nov 6). [PORTWATCH GAP -- STALE] Newest IMF PortWatch snapshot is portwatch-2026-10-26.json, stale=true, latest observation 2026-10-18 (4 Hormuz transits, 7-day avg 3.7 vs 2025 baseline 85.5/day). NO fresh counted transit figure exists for this item and none is cited. Fresher maritime count: JMIC Update 111 (Nov 5) -- 4 attacks in the Strait over 96 hours, Nov 1-3, off Musandam (recorded Nov 6).
sections.what_verified: 4 distinct publisher families, all tiered: Reuters (T1) carries the Tasnim/IRNA report; Al Jazeera (T2, STATE QA) liveblog carries IRNA + Tasnim + IRIB + the CENTCOM statement; IRNA / Press TV (T3, STATE IR) is the originator of the impact report; CENTCOM / US DoD (T1, STATE US) is the primary source for the 'relatively calm' line and the announcement promise. Times Now liveblog and Times of Israel liveblog also relay the same IRNA/Tasnim report but Times Now has NO declared tier in the registry and does not count; Times of Israel tier not relied on. Tasnim itself has NO declared tier and does not count separately.
sections.what_disputed: No US confirmation of any strike on Qeshm or of an MQ-9 loss; CENTCOM's own word is 'relatively calm'. Tasnim: 'no information from official sources has been released yet' on damage. US officials have denied prior MQ-9 claims as untrue (54th, Oct 20 -- Euronews; 55th, Nov 2 -- Air & Space Forces Magazine; US count of MQ-9 losses stuck at 45 since August vs Iran's claimed 56, per Firebrand Project). Unconfirmed Telegram claims of 'US airstrikes on Qeshm' and an un-sourced theory of Iranian warning shots near Bandar Khamir (newstracker24x7) are NOT adopted. No attribution of who fired the two missiles exists anywhere in the reporting.
sections.why_matters: Two missiles hit Qeshm Island tonight -- Iran says it downed a US MQ-9, Washington says 'relatively calm' and promises an announcement at 13:30 GMT. Who fired, and what does CENTCOM say next?
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP + IN-WINDOW UPDATE (IRNA first report 21:50 GMT Nov 6 = 01:50 ; Tasnim 21:55 GMT; CENTCOM 22:55 GMT = 02:55 ; MQ-9 claim 23:06 GMT = 03:06 ; zero 'Qeshm'/'Susa'/'two missiles' mentions in any prior Nov 7 scan -- grep confirms; Nov 2 Qeshm strikes are a SEPARATE recorded event) -- Two missiles strike Iran's Qeshm Island; Iran claims a US MQ-9 shot down over the island; CENTCOM calls the situation 'relatively calm' and promises an announcement on Iran at 08:30 EST Saturday
